Definition: a bulrush (as growing there); collectively a rope of bulrushes
BiblicalUsage: 1) rush, bulrush; 1a) used as cord or line (of twisted rushes or spun of rush fibre); 1b) of the lowly, insignificant (metaph); 2) sad, drooping; 1a) of line of bulrushes; 1b) bowing of the head (fig.); 1c) of the lowly (metaph)
